purpose: Independent confirmation of exactly two policy contrasts selected from the 30-repetition pilot, not a new allocation search
reuse: Unchanged pilot Problem, analytic derivatives, five starting points, bounds, higher B0/Bplus arrays, affine complex gains per field, shared interaction/source parameters, and sigma0=1.2931669440932318e-4
budget: Same total acquisition budget as pilot: full four-entry matrices on 45 frequencies, sigma_field=sigma0/sqrt(field_time_fraction); equal detector prefactors, no switching overhead or drift
pairing: Independent standard circular-complex noise per field, truth and repetition; identical draws reused within each candidate/baseline pair and rescaled by their time fractions. Confirmation seed differs from pilot. Different truth pairs use independent draws.
primary_statistic: D_i=(Ua_candidate_i-8)^2-(Ua_baseline_i-8)^2; report mean D, sample SD/sqrt(200), and interval mean D +/- z*SE. Negative D favors candidate.
multiple_comparisons: Exactly two primary contrasts. Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals use per-contrast two-sided 97.5% normal-approximation intervals, z=Phi^-1(0.9875) approximately 2.2414. These are Monte Carlo mean-loss comparisons, not parameter confidence intervals or exact finite-sample coverage.
failed_optimization: Retain every estimate and every start. Report optimizer statuses, bounds, and feasible synthetic-truth objective failures. A contrast containing a retained optimizer failure, bound hit, or truth-objective failure cannot support the primary precision claim without an explicitly separate investigation; no silent deletions or reruns.
secondary_outputs: RMSE and bias for each of the four declared truth/policy cases; all estimates and input/source hashes. No 50:50 contrast, new policy, or empirical allocation optimization.
stopping: Run the fixed 200 repetitions per truth regardless of intermediate result direction. Four disjoint repetition shards with one BLAS thread each.
